1031601.desc:
Combat End: At 10+ [Breath] Potency, gain 1 [Agility] next turn

At more than 20 [Breath] Potency, Base Skills deal +(excess Potency)% damage on Critical Hit (max 15%)
1031601.flavor:
The streets of the City are never short of vile and savage company after dark. Rats desperate to turn their lives around, denizens of the Backstreets harboring dreams of revenge, Syndicates and Fingers embroiled in struggles over their interests... and, of course, the Sweepers.

For all the fortunes to be made from working after sundown, few Fixers are eager to accept such contracts. There are, however, those who find their greatest opportunities precisely where others dare not tread.

The discernment to read any situation with remarkable precision. The swiftness and thoroughness to bring a job to its conclusion without inviting further trouble. With these two qualities as its greatest assets, Wedge Office has weathered every contract and walked away with the handsome compensation that follows.
1031601.name: Hunters of the City

1031602.desc:
In the Team Loadout menu:
- Equipping Wedge Office Fixer Don Quixote automatically equips Sinclair's Identity as Wedge Office Fixer Sinclair
- When Wedge Office Fixer Sinclair is unequipped, automatically equip the most recently equipped Identity that isn't Wedge Office Fixer Don Quixote (If Wedge Office Fixer Don Quixote Identity was already equipped when entering the Team Loadout menu, removing this Identity will automatically equip the LCB Sinner Don Quixote Identity instead)

From Turn Start ~ before Combat Start: If this unit's Speed is slower than allied Wedge Office Fixer Sinclair Identity's Speed, become faster until their Speed values are equal (this effect does not activate if either of the two Identities is at -45 SP, or is under an effect that fixes their Speed)
1031602.name: Ho, Young Sinclair! Thou Must Keep Apace!!

1031603.desc:
Turn Start: Gain 1 [BattleFieldKnow]

If any of the following conditions are met, inflict 1 [WedgeMarkYellow] on the main target (once per turn)
- On final Coin Hit using an Attack Skill against the main target
- Upon using this unit's Evade Skill to successfully evade all of the attacker's Coins
1031603.name: Wedge Drive

1031604.desc:
When the allied Dawn Office Fixer Faust Identity uses the "Dismemberment at High Noon" Skill, the Skill's Coin 1 gains the following effects (once per turn):
- [ComboSkill]: Wedge Office Fixer Don Quixote
  · [OnSucceedAttack] Inflict 2 [Combustion] and +2 [Combustion] Count
  · [OnSucceedAttack] Inflict 2 [Vibration]
  · [OnSucceedAttack] Inflict 1 [WedgeMarkYellow]
  · [OnSucceedAttack] Allied Wedge Office Rep Outis Identity gains 1 [ComboWedgeDawn]
1031604.name: Back-to-back in Dawnbreak's Light
